entries.heading: SECOND EXPANSION OF THE MY CAREER ADVANCEMENT ACCOUNT PROGRAM FOR MILITARY SPOUSES
ancestors: Subtitle H—Military Family Readiness and Dependents' Education
entries.text:
SEC. 580G. SECOND EXPANSION OF THE MY 
                          CAREER ADVANCEMENT ACCOUNT PROGRAM FOR 
                          MILITARY SPOUSES.

    The spouse of a member of the Coast Guard may participate in the My 
Career Advancement Account program of the Department of Defense if the 
Coast Guard reimburses the Department of Defense.
